title: Cost-Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference via Cross-Tier GPU Heterogeneity
research_focus: Multimodal serving, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Multimodal LLM inference splits into a compute-bound vision encoding phase and a memory-bandwidth-bound language decoding phase, yet existing serving systems deploy both on homogeneous datacenter GPUs, paying an HBM tax on the vision phase and a tensor-core tax on the decode phase. Prior stage-level disaggregation (PD/EPD) still transfers GB-scale KV caches per request, demanding NVLink or InfiniBand and precluding cross-tier deployment over commodity PCIe.
problem_statement.zh: Multimodal LLM 推理可拆解為 compute-bound 的 vision encoding 階段與 memory-bandwidth-bound 的 language decoding 階段；既有服務系統皆部署於同質 datacenter GPU，使 vision 階段浪費昂貴 HBM、decode 階段又閒置 tensor core。先前的 stage-level 解耦合（PD/EPD）每筆請求仍需傳輸 GB 等級的 KV cache，必須仰賴 NVLink 或 InfiniBand，無法在 commodity PCIe 上跨層級部署。

key_innovation.en: Modality-level disaggregation that partitions at the vision encoder/language decoder boundary, reducing per-request cross-device transfer from O(L·s_ctx) KV bytes to O(N_v·d) embedding bytes (MB-scale, 12x-196x reduction across MLLM architectures). A closed-form cost model (Eqs. 5-8) decomposes T_e2e = T_vision + T_xfer + T_prefill + T_decode and proves heterogeneous deployment is cost-optimal when phases are separable. HeteroServe runtime maps vision to consumer RTX 4090 and decode to A100, with cross-type work stealing for utilization recovery.
key_innovation.zh: Modality-level 解耦合：將 inference graph 切在 vision encoder 與 language decoder 邊界，使每筆請求跨裝置傳輸量從 O(L·s_ctx) KV bytes 降至 O(N_v·d) embedding bytes（MB 等級，跨 MLLM 架構達 12x-196x 縮減）。論文提出 closed-form cost model（Eqs. 5-8），將 T_e2e = T_vision + T_xfer + T_prefill + T_decode 分解，並證明在 phase-separable workload 下，異質部署為成本最優。HeteroServe runtime 將 vision 配置於消費級 RTX 4090、decode 配置於 A100，並透過 cross-type work stealing 回收利用率。

key_improvements.en: Heterogeneous configuration (2x RTX 4090 + 2x A100, $38k) achieves 37% higher Tokens/$ over homogeneous 4x A100 baseline ($64k) at matched latency. Engine optimizations alone raise throughput by 54% over vLLM v0.3.0 on identical hardware. Cost model predicts 31.4% savings; observed 40.6%. Work stealing yields additional 1.13x speedup.
key_improvements.zh: 異質部署（2x RTX 4090 + 2x A100，$38k）相較同質 4x A100 baseline（$64k），在匹配延遲下 Tokens/$ 提升 37%。Engine optimizations 在同硬體上相較 vLLM v0.3.0 吞吐量提升 54%。Cost model 預測節省 31.4%；實測達 40.6%。Work stealing 額外帶來 1.13x 加速。

reported_accuracy: Predicts 31.4% cost savings vs. 40.6% observed (relative error ~23%)
validation_workloads: COCO 2017 validation (prompt: Describe this image in detail, max output 128 tokens)

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes standard transformer KV caching (no activation recomputation, KV offloading, or speculative decoding altering intermediate state sizes); assumes phase-separable workloads; PCIe Gen4 x16 bandwidth (~25 GB/s); embedding transfer time treated as negligible (<0.3% overhead). T_lang grouped as T_prefill + T_decode; ignores network latency beyond the cross-tier embedding hop.
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設使用標準 transformer KV caching（不含 activation recomputation、KV offloading 或會改變中介狀態大小的 speculative decoding）；假設 workload 為 phase-separable；PCIe Gen4 x16 頻寬約 25 GB/s；embedding 傳輸時間視為可忽略（<0.3% overhead）。將 T_lang 合併為 T_prefill + T_decode；忽略跨層級 embedding 傳輸以外的網路延遲。
